name: provision-agent-workspace
job: Provision an agent filesystem and shell workspace with isolation class matched to risk and free-boundary honesty.

inScope: Choosing the isolation and cost class that matches risk
Confirming filesystem and exec canary proofs
Tearing down or standing by per provider policy
outOfScope: Production multi-tenant compute without account, quotas, and security review
Claiming free hosted infinite Linux from an OSS package
Public-page lookup via host web search and fetch tools

inputs: Workload needs: files, builds, tests, or state across turns
Provider constraints: TTL, disk, CPU, egress, concurrency
outputs: Provider free class, isolation boundary, and residual risk list

tools: workspace CLI for the selected provider

failureSemantics: Long-lived secrets are not placed in ephemeral storage without a wipe plan; preview sandboxes are treated as hostile multi-tenant until proven otherwise; standby or resume is only assumed when the provider documents it.

outcome.observable: A provisioned workspace with documented handle, filesystem and exec canary proofs, stated isolation class and free boundaries, and reap or TTL policy with residual risks.
